# `aitbc dispute evidence add`

Submit evidence for a dispute.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc dispute evidence add [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--dispute-id` | integer | — | yes | Dispute the evidence belongs to. |
| `--evidence-hash` | text | — | yes | Content hash of the evidence. |
| `--evidence-type` | text | — | yes | Evidence category, e.g. transcript or receipt. |
| `--description` | text | — | yes | What the evidence shows. |
| `--node-url` | text | — | no | Blockchain node RPC URL |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc dispute evidence add --dispute-id <dispute_id> --evidence-hash <evidence_hash> --evidence-type <evidence_type> --description <description>
```
